articles.title: Tether: Senator's investigation misses positive work that's led to lower Iran volumes
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer's CEO, Paolo Ardoino, has been defending against accusations that the firm's stablecoins have fueled financial activity in Iran.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
articles.snippet: The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.

articles.title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
articles.snippet: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.

articles.title: Visa, Mesh partner to enable crypto spending at 175M merchant locations
articles.snippet: Mesh will connect crypto and stablecoin wallets to Visa’s global payment network, allowing users to spend digital assets without a separate card.

articles.title: Mastercard launches stablecoin risk screening for banks and payment providers
articles.snippet: The new service combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks detect suspicious stablecoin transactions before settlement.
